Basestation Tool

Changelog

2026-11-14

v0.1.1

  • When waking a station from sleep or standby, the app shows “Starting up”. When the station reports 0x0B, the label changes to “On (0x0B)”.
  • Use Identify to flash the LED of a single selected station.
  • If the station was in sleep or standby before identification, the tool restores that state after 15 seconds and checks it over Bluetooth.
2026-11-10

v0.1.0

  • First public release for Windows and Linux with individual and group control, SteamVR automation and channel selection.
